# Task file reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_schema_docs.py from schemas/v1/task.schema.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract: `https://example.org/governed-harness/schemas/v1/task.schema.json` (JSON Schema 2020-12).

`harness task create --file task.yaml` accepts YAML or JSON and persists a task that
validates against this schema. The loader is lenient: a requirement or acceptance
criterion may be a plain string, a missing `taskId` or item id is generated, snake_case
aliases are accepted, `projectId` defaults to the project and `schemaVersion` and
`createdAt` are set by the harness. Unknown top-level keys are ignored, and a missing
`title` or `intent` is currently stored as the text `None` instead of being rejected
(issue #29), so always provide both.

## Task

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acceptanceCriteria` | array of [AcceptanceCriterion](#acceptancecriterion) | yes |  |
| `constraints` | array of string | no |  |
| `createdAt` | string (date-time) | no |  |
| `criteriaPending` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `implementation` | [ImplementationInstruction](#implementationinstruction) | no |  |
| `intent` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 16000 |
| `metadata` | object | no |  |
| `projectId` | string | yes |  |
| `requirements` | array of [Requirement](#requirement) | no |  |
| `schemaVersion` | `1.0` | no | default `"1.0"` |
| `taskId` | string | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 300 |

## AcceptanceCriterion

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `criterionId` | string | yes |  |
| `priority` | `MUST` \| `SHOULD` \| `COULD` | no | default `"MUST"` |
| `text` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 8000 |
| `verificationHint` | string or null | no | max length 4000 |

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |

| `expectedSha256` | string or null | no |  |
| `operation` | `create` \| `replace` \| `append` \| `delete` | yes |  |
| `path` | string | yes |  |

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
